attempts.summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) as a router between lan-a (node2) and lan-b (node3) using an Ansible playbook run from control_node node4, with plain routing (no NAT) so original source addresses are preserved. node1 eth1/eth2 got 10.60.10.254/24 and 10.60.20.254/24; node2/node3 enp8s0 got static addresses plus routes to the peer LAN via node1, and enp8s0 was moved into firewalld's trusted zone (persisted via NM connection.zone) so all ports, not just ICMP, are reachable. Verified bidirectionally with ping and arbitrary-port HTTP, confirming the peer's true source IP is observed (no NAT). All 4 managed nodes were then restarted one at a time via native reboot, with boot_id proven to change and post-restart health/config/connectivity verified for each.
